title: 2026 non-hermetically sealed F-gas equipment installer verification QA

sources.title: Selling F gas in cylinders or equipment
Labelling F gas equipment you produce, import or install

facts.source_fact: F-gas equipment may be sold in hermetically or non-hermetically sealed form.
Hermetically sealed equipment has the F-gas-containing part permanently sealed.
Capped valves or service ports do not prevent equipment being classed as hermetically sealed if the permanent-seal criterion is met.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer non-hermetic solely from capped ports.

facts.source_fact: Hermetically sealed equipment must have a tested leak rate below 3 grams per year.
Before selling non-hermetically sealed equipment, the seller must ask the end user for details of the qualified installer.
Installer details should be obtained in writing.
The seller must check that the installer's details are valid.
The installer-detail steps do not apply to hermetically sealed equipment.
The rule concerns sale/installation compliance rather than the measured operating leak rate of a specific parcel.
Seal classification and installer qualification are distinct compliance attributes.
